info.title: Matomo Reporting API for AbTesting plugin

get.description: Returns overview metrics for each variation in an experiment.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).

parameters.name: idExperiment
parameters.description: The experiment ID to report on.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

200.description:
Data table containing the selected success metrics and base variation metrics.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns detailed report metrics for one success metric in an experiment.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).

parameters.name: idExperiment
parameters.description: The experiment ID to report on.

parameters.name: successMetric
parameters.description: Success metric ID assigned to the experiment, for example "nb_pageviews".

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

200.description:
Data table containing detailed metrics such as significance and remaining visitors.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Creates a new experiment with variations, targeting rules, and success metrics.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The experiment name.

parameters.name: hypothesis
parameters.description: The hypothesis to test.

schema.example: A shorter signup flow will improve conversions.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The experiment description shown in the UI.

schema.example: Compare the pricing page signup experience for New Zealand traffic.

parameters.name: variations
parameters.description: Variation definitions. Each variation requires a name and can include percentage and redirect_url values.

parameters.name: includedTargets
parameters.description: Targeting rules that must match for the experiment to run.

parameters.name: successMetrics
parameters.description: Success metrics to evaluate for the experiment.

200.description:
The ID of the created experiment.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Updates an existing experiment and its reporting configuration.

parameters.name: idExperiment
parameters.description: The experiment ID to update.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The experiment name.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The experiment description shown in the UI.

schema.example: Compare the pricing page signup experience for New Zealand traffic.

parameters.name: hypothesis
parameters.description: The hypothesis to test.

schema.example: A shorter signup flow will improve conversions.

parameters.name: variations
parameters.description: Variation definitions. Each variation requires a name and can include percentage and redirect_url values.

parameters.name: confidenceThreshold
parameters.description: Confidence threshold to use for significance calculations. Allowed values: 90, 95, 98, 99, 99.5

parameters.name: mdeRelative
parameters.description: Minimum detectable effect percentage.

parameters.name: percentageParticipants
parameters.description: Percentage of visitors that should participate in the experiment.

parameters.name: successMetrics
parameters.description: Success metrics to evaluate for the experiment.

parameters.name: includedTargets
parameters.description: Targeting rules that must match for the experiment to run.

parameters.name: excludedTargets
parameters.description: Targeting rules that exclude visitors from the experiment.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Optional UTC start date in 'Y-m-d H:i:s' format, or false for no scheduled start date.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Optional UTC end date in 'Y-m-d H:i:s' format, or false for no scheduled end date.

parameters.name: forwardUtmParams
parameters.description: Whether redirects should forward `utm*` query parameters.

parameters.name: forwardAllQueryParams
parameters.description: Whether redirects should forward all query parameters.

parameters.name: idExperiment
parameters.description: The experiment ID to start.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

formatRequired.name: format

flatOptional.name: flat

filter_truncateOptional.name: filter_truncate

filter_limitOptional.name: filter_limit

labelOptional.name: label
